# SCI-FRUIT EL-F6 interpretation direction

Date: 2026-09-03

Status: **scientific-owner direction to correct the EL-F6 interpretation while
preserving the registered experiment and result**

After reviewing the EL-F6 a1400 residual figure, the scientific owner observed
that the apparent source was distributed over several arcs and asked whether
this represented a pointing problem. A read-only decomposition found a compact
injected core plus scan-shaped non-kernel structure. The structure is strongly
caused by the branch-dependent UID 4460 exclusion and includes failure of the
real Neptune field and scan-synchronous material to cancel between injected
and control reductions. It is not evidence that the injected compact source
itself was smeared into the arcs.

The manager recommended retaining the registered approximately 96-percent
causal reversal while reclassifying the affected annular structure as
scan-synchronous/operator-mismatch leakage in the total paired response. The
owner replied:

> sounds good, please do so

This direction authorizes the interpretation revision, corrected diagnostic
figure, manifest, and living-status update. It does not authorize editing the
preserved r0.1 evidence, rerunning a reduction, changing an algorithm or
configuration, launching another empirical test, qualifying a recurrence, or
beginning Stage B.
